nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Mission Control admin API exposing GET (list pipeline modules with health status) and PATCH (toggle module enabled/disabled) over the supabase pipeline_modules table.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns the list of mission-control pipeline modules from Supabase as JSON for the admin dashboard.

nodes.name: PATCH
nodes.summary: Updates an individual pipeline module record (e.g. toggling enabled/status fields) by id in Supabase.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Mission Control pipeline admin API: GET returns aggregate pipeline status, POST triggers pipeline-wide actions (start/stop/restart) by writing to Supabase.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Reads pipeline state aggregates from Supabase and returns them as the mission-control pipeline overview payload.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Accepts pipeline control commands and dispatches them by mutating pipeline state in Supabase.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Mission Control admin endpoint that restarts a pipeline module: validates input, resets its Supabase status record, and returns the new module state.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Handles a restart request for a specified pipeline module by clearing its status and writing fresh fields back to Supabase.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Mission Control admin endpoint that lists recent template-related records from Supabase for the dashboard's templates panel.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Queries Supabase for the latest template entries and returns them as JSON to the mission-control UI.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin API for evaluating prediction models: GET runs the benchmark via benchmark-runner, POST logs experiment results to Supabase, with handleLogExperiment computing summary metrics like Spearman correlation.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Invokes the benchmark runner against the active model and returns evaluation metrics as JSON.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Routes incoming model-evaluation POSTs to handleLogExperiment for persistence.

nodes.name: handleLogExperiment
nodes.summary: Validates an experiment payload, computes summary metrics (e.g. rounded correlations), and writes the experiment record to Supabase.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Thin admin endpoint that delegates to the canary promote service to swap the active model only if the shadow model beats current production metrics.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint that sets the shadow model identifier (read from env helpers) for canary evaluation runs.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Accepts a model id and persists it as the shadow model for subsequent canary evaluations.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive monitoring admin API aggregating real-time metrics, analytics, business KPIs, alerts, and system health across the platform; POST routes manual alert/report/notification actions through the monitoring subsystems.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Dispatches monitoring read requests to overview, performance, business, alerting, analytics, or system-health helpers based on the requested view.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Handles monitoring control actions (trigger alert, generate report, ack/resolve alert, test notification, force collection) by delegating to alert and analytics services.

nodes.name: getMonitoringOverview
nodes.summary: Builds a high-level monitoring overview by combining real-time metrics, system health summary, and quick insights.

nodes.name: getPerformanceMetrics
nodes.summary: Collects performance metrics (response times, percentiles, trends) via the metrics-collector and shapes them for the monitoring API.

nodes.name: getBusinessMetrics
nodes.summary: Loads business KPIs and revenue forecasts from the business-metrics-dashboard service.

nodes.name: getAlertingStatus
nodes.summary: Summarises active alerts, recent alert history, rule counts, and configured channels for the monitoring dashboard.

nodes.name: getAnalyticsData
nodes.summary: Returns analytics reports and forecasts produced by the analytics-reporting service.

nodes.name: getSystemHealth
nodes.summary: Computes overall system health by composing service status, database health, external service status, and health recommendations.

nodes.name: triggerManualAlert
nodes.summary: Fires a manual alert through the alert-system service using the request payload.

nodes.name: testNotification
nodes.summary: Sends a test notification through configured channels to verify alert delivery wiring.

nodes.name: getRealTimeMetrics
nodes.summary: Snapshots current real-time metrics from the real-time-monitor for inclusion in the monitoring overview.

nodes.name: getSystemHealthSummary
nodes.summary: Produces a compact health summary (overall score and status counts) from current monitoring inputs.

nodes.name: getQuickInsights
nodes.summary: Derives short-form actionable insights (top issues, key wins) for the monitoring overview card.

nodes.name: generateHealthRecommendations
nodes.summary: Produces remediation recommendations based on current service and database health checks.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Monitoring dashboard admin API that compiles performance metrics, system health, real-time stats, alerts, and trend data into the dashboard payload using the metrics-collector and alert-manager services.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Top-level dashboard handler that applies auth + rate limiting, then assembles performance, health, real-time, alert, and trend sections into a single response.

nodes.name: getPerformanceMetrics
nodes.summary: Aggregates response-time samples and percentile breakdowns from the metrics-collector for the dashboard performance panel.

nodes.name: getSystemHealth
nodes.summary: Computes service-by-service health, CPU usage, and active user counts for the dashboard health card.

nodes.name: getRealTimeMetrics
nodes.summary: Snapshots the current real-time metrics (throughput, latency, errors) for the dashboard live panel.

nodes.name: getAlertSummary
nodes.summary: Builds an alert summary from the alert-manager (counts by severity, recent alerts) for the dashboard.

nodes.name: getTrendData
nodes.summary: Assembles trend datasets (performance, business, alerts) for the dashboard's time-series charts.

nodes.name: getPerformanceTrends
nodes.summary: Returns historical performance samples used to render the dashboard performance trend chart.

nodes.name: getBusinessTrends
nodes.summary: Returns business KPI trend series used by the dashboard business chart.

nodes.name: calculateOverallHealth
nodes.summary: Combines performance, system, and alert signals into a single weighted overall-health score.

nodes.name: getStartTime
nodes.summary: Resolves a start timestamp from a relative range string (e.g. '1h', '7d') for time-window queries.

nodes.name: getActiveUsersCount
nodes.summary: Estimates currently active users for the dashboard's health card.

nodes.name: route.ts.disabled
nodes.summary: Disabled (renamed) Next.js route that previously exposed fast-prediction monitoring; retained in the tree for reference but not registered with the router.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Tiny synthetic monitoring endpoint that returns a constant health payload guarded by an env flag, used as a heartbeat probe.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin API simulating the 'omniscient flow' integration tests: POST dispatches sub-tests (video analysis, template generation, viral prediction, feedback, performance), GET reports stats and health.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Routes omniscient-flow POST actions to the appropriate handler (full test, batch processing, individual report types).

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Dispatches GET queries to the stats and health-check handlers for omniscient flow monitoring.

nodes.name: handleTestOmniscientFlow
nodes.summary: Runs the full omniscient flow integration test, exercising the major reporting paths and aggregating per-stage outcomes.

nodes.name: handleReportVideoAnalysis
nodes.summary: Records a synthetic video-analysis report into the omniscient flow's event stream.

nodes.name: handleReportTemplateGeneration
nodes.summary: Records a synthetic template-generation event into the omniscient flow's event stream.

nodes.name: handleReportViralPrediction
nodes.summary: Records a synthetic viral-prediction event for the omniscient flow integration test.

nodes.name: handleReportUserFeedback
nodes.summary: Records a synthetic user-feedback event for the omniscient flow integration test.

nodes.name: handleReportPerformanceMetrics
nodes.summary: Records a synthetic performance-metrics event for the omniscient flow integration test.

nodes.name: handleProcessBatch
nodes.summary: Invokes the omniscient-flow batch processor with the requested payload.

nodes.name: handleGetStats
nodes.summary: Returns aggregate stats for omniscient flow runs.

nodes.name: handleHealthCheck
nodes.summary: Returns a simple health-check response for the omniscient flow subsystem.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Operations admin API that projects prediction-accuracy milestones (week/date) using training-eligibility data and the supabase server client.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Computes and returns accuracy operations metrics including milestone projections and training-data readiness, sourced from Supabase.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Operations admin API returning the full initiative dashboard payload by querying multiple Supabase tables (initiatives, phases, status) and shaping them for the UI.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Reads initiative records and related operations data from Supabase, then assembles the initiative dashboard JSON response.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Pack Health Dashboard backend that derives component/pack status from prediction_runs + run_component_results in Supabase, including API-key indicators and XGBoost model version.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Queries recent prediction runs and component results, evaluates which packs/components are active or degraded, and returns the system-health dashboard payload.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Ops admin endpoint that posts a notification through the alarm + notifier services for incident-response wiring.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Receives a notify payload and dispatches it through the alarms and notifier modules.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin test endpoint exercising the Phase 2 DPS v2 path: builds a sample viral-prediction input and runs it through dps-v2 to verify wiring.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Constructs a synthetic prediction input, runs it through dps-v2, and returns the computed scores for verification.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin API that executes pipeline control actions: POST dispatches per-module or batch actions through handleModuleAction/handleBatchAction; GET returns the actions catalog.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Routes pipeline-action POSTs to either single-module or batch handlers based on the payload shape.

nodes.name: handleModuleAction
nodes.summary: Executes a single named action against one pipeline module (start, stop, restart, reset) and returns the resulting status.

nodes.name: handleBatchAction
nodes.summary: Performs the same action across many pipeline modules in batch, aggregating per-module results into one response.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns the metadata catalog describing all supported pipeline actions.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin API that probes each pipeline service (scraper, decomposer, gene-tagger, template generator, evolution engine, recipe-book, DNA detective, orchestrator, advisor, feedback ingest) and returns an aggregated status payload.

nodes.name: getApifyScraperStatus
nodes.summary: Probes the Apify scraper service and returns its current health, last-run, and queue depth metrics.

nodes.name: getFeatureDecomposerStatus
nodes.summary: Probes the feature decomposer and returns last-run state, throughput, and error counts.

nodes.name: getGeneTaggerStatus
nodes.summary: Probes the gene-tagger service and reports its activity and recent classifications.

nodes.name: getTemplateGeneratorStatus
nodes.summary: Probes the template generator service and reports generation rates and recent outputs.

nodes.name: getEvolutionEngineStatus
nodes.summary: Probes the evolution engine and reports its current state, generation counts, and recent improvements.

nodes.name: getRecipeBookAPIStatus
nodes.summary: Probes the recipe-book API and returns counts of registered recipes and last-update times.

nodes.name: getDNADetectiveStatus
nodes.summary: Probes the DNA-detective service and returns detection rates and confidence statistics.

nodes.name: getOrchestratorStatus
nodes.summary: Probes the pipeline orchestrator and reports queue depth, active jobs, and last completed run.

nodes.name: getAdvisorServiceStatus
nodes.summary: Probes the advisor service and returns recommendation volume, accuracy hints, and recent activity.

nodes.name: getFeedbackIngestStatus
nodes.summary: Probes the feedback ingestion service and returns recent ingestion rates and error counts.

nodes.name: getRelativeTime
nodes.summary: Formats an absolute timestamp as a relative human-readable string (e.g. '5m ago').

nodes.name: calculatePipelineHealth
nodes.summary: Combines per-service status into a single pipeline-wide health score and label.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Invokes every per-service status probe in parallel, aggregates results, and returns the unified pipeline status payload.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Dynamic admin route that executes a named pipeline action (e.g. recompute recipes) using helpers from the pipeline _lib and the recipes compute service.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Switches on the route param's action name to invoke the appropriate pipeline helper (compute, reset, etc.) and returns the result.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint that acknowledges a pipeline alert by id using the shared pipeline _lib helpers.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Reads an alert id from the request body and marks it acknowledged through the pipeline alerts helper.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint that resolves a pipeline alert by id via the pipeline _lib helpers.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Receives an alert id and marks the alert resolved through the pipeline alerts helper.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint that lists current pipeline alerts, falling back to synthetic data from _synthetic when no real alerts are available.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns the current list of pipeline alerts, blending real data via _lib with synthetic seed data from _synthetic when needed.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint that returns the pipeline backlog (pending jobs) merging real data and synthetic placeholders via the pipeline _lib helpers.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Reads the pipeline backlog (queued/pending jobs) and returns it for the admin UI.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint that returns recent pipeline changelog entries via the pipeline _lib helpers.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns recent pipeline changelog entries for the admin UI.
